fc1e24.conditions: none; wildcard probes are separated by tags and by the per-level Allreduce in FindNumReplies
fc1e24.reasoning: ParaSails' wildcard probes (ReceiveRequest, ReceiveReplyPrunedRows, ReceiveReplyStoredRows, DiagScale server, LoadBal) all immediately Recv from the probed source with the same tag, so probe and receive always match the same message. In ExchangePrunedRows with 2 levels, requests use per-level tags (221/227) and each level has an Allreduce (FindNumReplies) that no rank can leave before every rank has finished the previous level's request and reply loops. So level l+1 requests or replies (ROW_REPI_TAG) cannot reach a rank still in level l, and stored-row replies cannot exist before that rank's own stored request. Within a level each peer sends at most one message per tag, the counts are exact, and handling is order-independent (replies keyed by source and row numbers). REPV follows REPI from the same source in order. hypre's DataExchangeList and assumed partition are the standard correct algorithms. Irsend is used only after the matching Irecv was posted before the Allreduce.
